error.file-parent-folder: Choose “%{folder}” or one of its parent folders to allow saving this file.
error.obsidian-vault-folder: Choose the root of an Obsidian vault containing its .obsidian folder.
error.file-missing: “%{name}” is no longer there. It may have been renamed, moved or deleted; choose the notes folder again.
error.file-permission: Markraft is not allowed to use “%{name}”. Check its permissions in Finder, or choose another notes folder.
error.file-exists: “%{name}” already exists. Rename or move it, then try again.
error.file-invalid-name: “%{name}” is not a name this disk accepts. Shorten the note's first line, then try again.
error.disk-full: The disk has no room left for “%{name}”. Free some space, then try again.
error.disk-read-only: “%{name}” is on a disk that cannot be written to. Choose a notes folder on a disk you can write to.
error.file-timeout: “%{name}” did not respond in time. If it is on a network drive or in iCloud, check the connection and try again.
error.export-over-note: “%{name}” is one of your notes. Export to another name so the note is kept.
error.print-failed: The note could not be laid out for printing (%{detail}).
error.pdf-failed: “%{name}” could not be written. Choose another place, then try again.
error.trash-unavailable: System Trash is not available on this platform.
error.saved-state: Cannot read the folder's saved state: %{detail}
error.conflict-note: “%{title}” changed on disk. Your edits were saved as a copy.
error.invalid-bounds: The window size Markraft remembered cannot be used, so it stopped before saving. Resize the window, then try again.
error.library-version: These notes were written by a different version of Markraft. Update Markraft, then open them again.
error.duplicate-notes: Markraft cannot tell two of your notes apart, so it stopped before saving. Reload the folder to use the notes on disk.
error.active-note-missing: Markraft lost track of which note is open, so it stopped before saving. Open a note from the list, then try again.
error.settings-reset: Settings were unreadable and have been reset.
error.settings-encode: Markraft could not prepare your settings for saving.
error.conflict-kept: Changed on disk. Your edits were saved as a copy.
error.conflicts-kept: %{count} notes changed on disk. Your edits were saved as copies.
error.settings-outside-folder: Application settings must be stored outside the Markdown folder.
error.folder-locked: Another Markraft instance is already using this folder.
error.folder-settings-reset: Folder settings were unreadable and have been reset.
error.not-utf8: This file is not UTF-8 text. Open it in another editor to convert its encoding.
error.rename-unsaved: Save this note to a file before renaming it.
error.rename-pending: A note changed on disk. Wait a moment, then try renaming again.
error.no-recovery-path: This note has no file to keep a copy beside.
error.new-note-outside: The new-note location must stay inside the notes folder.
error.unreadable-markdown: This file is not Markdown Markraft can read.
error.path-outside: Path is outside the notes folder
error.symlink-directory: A destination directory is a symbolic link; choose a real directory.
error.symlink-read-only: Symbolic links are read-only in Markraft.
error.hardlink-read-only: Hard-linked files are read-only in Markraft.
error.changed-during-save: The file changed while saving. Your changes were not written.
error.invalid-name: A name cannot contain / : \ [ ] # ^ | or begin or end with a period.
error.folder-settings-save: Folder settings could not be saved: %{detail}
error.recovery-cleanup: Old recovery drafts could not be cleared: %{detail}
error.files-deleted: %{count} notes' files were deleted outside Markraft.
error.rename-changed: “%{title}” changed on disk. Refresh before renaming it.
error.note-changed: “%{title}” changed on disk, so it was not overwritten.
error.markdown-preserve: This edit cannot preserve the original Markdown safely: %{detail}
error.updates-unbundled: Updates work only in the installed app.
error.updates-unconfigured: This copy can't update. Install a release from GitHub.
error.native-window: Markraft could not find its own window. Quit and reopen Markraft.
error.saving-stopped: Saving stopped working. Copy your note (⇧⌘C), then quit and reopen Markraft.
error.worker-folder-unreachable: Markraft can no longer reach your notes folder. Copy your note (⇧⌘C), then quit and reopen Markraft.
error.worker-read-stopped: Markraft stopped reading your notes folder before it had finished. Copy your note (⇧⌘C), then quit and reopen Markraft.
error.worker-timeout: The notes folder is taking too long to respond. The request may still complete; your note remains open. Try again.
error.worker-no-response: The save worker stopped before responding. Copy your note (⇧⌘C), then quit and reopen Markraft.
error.launch-too-many: Too many file paths for one launch. Open a smaller group of files.
error.local-files-only: Only local file URLs can be opened.
error.instance-unresponsive: Markraft is already running, but it did not answer. Wait a moment and open it again, or quit it from the menu bar first.
error.relaunch-link: Markraft could not set up the link that a second launch uses to reopen its window. Quit Markraft and open it again.
error.launch-path-count: An open request needs 1–%{max} absolute file paths.
error.launch-queue: Could not queue the open request: %{detail}
error.updater-main-thread: The updater must start on the macOS main thread.
error.updater-mock: The mock updater requires the isolated update-test app bundle.
error.crash-notice: Markraft quit unexpectedly. A report was saved.
error.shortcut-release: Markraft could not release the shortcut it was using. Quit and reopen Markraft, then set it again.
error.shortcut-taken: A shortcut was taken by another app while it was being changed. Choose a different shortcut.
error.native-window-control: Markraft could not take charge of its window, so it cannot float above other apps. Quit and reopen Markraft.
error.login-version: Launch at login requires macOS 13 or later.
error.bundle-not-found: macOS could not find the Markraft app bundle.
error.bundle-location: Could not locate the app bundle.
error.install-for-login: Move Markraft.app to Applications and launch that copy before enabling launch at login.
error.menu-bar-unavailable: Markraft could not put its icon in the menu bar. Notes still work, but the menu bar item and the shortcut that opens them are unavailable.
error.shortcut-invalid: “%{shortcut}” is not a shortcut Markraft understands. Try one like Alt+N or Ctrl+Shift+Space.
error.shortcut-duplicate: “%{shortcut}” is already Markraft's other shortcut. Choose a different one.
error.shortcut-unavailable: “%{shortcut}” is not available — another app is probably using it. Choose a different shortcut.
error.login-enable: Could not enable launch at login: %{detail}. Use a signed Markraft app installed in Applications, and check System Settings → General → Login Items & Extensions.
error.login-disable: Could not disable launch at login: %{detail}. Use a signed Markraft app installed in Applications, and check System Settings → General → Login Items & Extensions.
error.login-not-applied: macOS has not applied the change. Check System Settings → General → Login Items & Extensions.
error.login-approval: Allow Markraft in System Settings → General → Login Items & Extensions to enable launch at login.
error.newer-folder: A newer version of Markraft last opened this folder. Update Markraft to open it.
error.recovery-retry: Some changes aren't saved yet; Markraft will retry.
error.settings-is-folder: Markraft needs a settings file to work with, not a folder.
error.native-no-detail: macOS did not provide an error description
